title: Number of Islands
summary: Count connected groups of land in a rectangular grid.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–300 rows and 1–300 columns. Every cell is the string 0 or 1. The result is the number of land components.

statement: Count connected groups of land in a rectangular grid. The character 1 marks land, and 0 marks water. Land cells connect only through shared edges.

examples.explanation: The two left cells connect, while the upper-right cell is isolated.
A diagonal touch does not connect land.

constraints: 1–300 rows and 1–300 columns. Every cell is the string 0 or 1. The result is the number of land components.
hints: Conceptual: One island may contain many cells, so counting land cells overcounts.
Directional: Flood-fill from each unvisited land cell.
Implementation: When a new island is found, mark its whole component using a queue or stack. Only then continue scanning.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(mn) auxiliary space with a separate visited grid and iterative traversal.
